ShortDescription.Value: Display current system time in CSL2 toolbar.

Publish.LongDescription:
**This mod displays the current system time in the toolbar.**
### Features
- Toolbar clock displaying system time - Works both in game and in editor - Customizable display format - Clock width adjustable in settings - Option to making the clock blink every hour (require enabling in the settings) - Localizations included (require [I18n Everywhere](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/75426/Windows) Mod) with machine translation.
### Motivation
Since the wonderful [System Clock Mod](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/107257/Windows) hadn't been updated for about a month when 1.3.6f1 patch dropped, I figured maybe I could put together a replacement so I don't lose track of time ever so often. (That mod has been updated now, but I am already in this too deep to stop.)
So, welcome to my first experimental mod for Cities: Skylines II, which is also my first C#/React/TypeScript project.
Enjoy!
(As a general precaution when using mods, remember to **always backup your saves**.)
### Acknowledgements
Thank you @rcav8tr for your very helpful and detailed [guide](https://github.com/rcav8tr/CS2-Modding-Instructions) on CSL2 Modding. This mod couldn't have happened without you.
Thank you @liberaldev / ssharp0 for your [SystemClockMod](https://github.com/liberaldev/SystemClockMod) which is of much inspirations for this project. (Though I have rewritten the codebase to learn about CSL2 modding.)
